lessons.title: Welcome Back: How Do I Feel?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express how they feel about starting a new term.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss what children did over the holidays.
lessons.main_activity: Children share how they feel about the new term using feeling face cards, discussing that mixed feelings are normal.
key_questions: How do you feel about the new term?
What are you looking forward to?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note emotional vocabulary and reflection — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class welcome-back circle.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your holiday highlights with family.

lessons.title: Sharing Holiday News
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to talk about a holiday experience using full sentences.
lessons.starter_activity: Adult shares a simple holiday story.
lessons.main_activity: Children share a holiday memory with a partner using full sentences.
key_questions: What did you do in the holidays?
What was your favourite part?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sentence complexity after the break — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share interesting holiday news as a class.
lessons.home_link: Look at a holiday photo together and talk about it.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'x'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'x' and blend words (box, fox, mix).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned before the holidays.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'x' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
key_questions: What sound is this?
Can you blend b-o-x?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'x'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 22 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending box, fox, mix.

lessons.title: Counting Recap: New Year, New Numbers
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to count confidently to 10 and beyond after the holiday break.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the new year number (e.g. what year is it now).
lessons.main_activity: Assess and recap counting skills with a variety of objects, extending confident counters towards counting to 20.
key_questions: Can you count to 10? To 20?
What number comes after this one?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap of counting ability for the new term — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class count-along to 20 together.
lessons.home_link: Practise counting as high as you can at home.

lessons.title: Setting a New Year Goal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name one simple thing they would like to get better at.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss the idea of a 'new year goal' simply (something to try).
lessons.main_activity: Children choose and draw one simple goal (e.g. writing their name, being kind, trying new food) for the term.
key_questions: What would you like to get better at?
How will you practise?

differentiation.extension: Explain how they will work towards their goal

lessons.assessment_notes: Note goal-setting language — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Share goals with the class.
lessons.home_link: Talk about your new goal with family and how they can help.

lessons.title: Listening Recap: Following Instructions
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to follow 2-3 step instructions confidently after the break.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sequencing words.
lessons.main_activity: Play an instruction-following game to assess/recap listening skills, gradually increasing instruction complexity.
key_questions: What do you do first?
Can you repeat the instructions?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap of instruction-following for the new term — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Children give instructions to a partner.
lessons.home_link: Practise following 2-3 step instructions for a chore at home.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'Squirrel's New Year's Resolution'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain what the character wanted to change.
lessons.starter_activity: Predict from the cover.
lessons.main_activity: Read a simple new-year-themed story about trying something new, discussing the character's goal.
key_questions: What did the character want to change?
Did they succeed?

differentiation.extension: Explain reasoning for the character's goal

lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension linking to the topic — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Recap the story's message about trying new things.
lessons.home_link: Talk about trying something new together this week.

lessons.title: Number Bonds Recap: Baseline Check
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall number bonds to 5 (and beyond for some) after the break.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire number bonds to 5 quiz.
lessons.main_activity: Assess/recap number bonds to 5 with counters, extending confident children to number bonds to 10.
key_questions: What are the ways to make 5?
Can you find ways to make 10?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the new term — evidence for MATHS.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of all bonds found.
lessons.home_link: Practise number bonds with any small objects at home.

lessons.title: New Term Routines Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall and follow classroom routines independently.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap classroom rules from the start of the year.
lessons.main_activity: Practise key routines (coat pegs, snack time, tidy up) with increasing independence, praising confident routine-following.
key_questions: What do we do when we arrive?
Can you do this routine independently?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note growing independence with routines — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Recap all routines followed well today.
lessons.home_link: Practise a morning routine independently at home.

lessons.title: Talking About My New Year Goal
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to explain their goal from Tuesday using 'because'.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap Tuesday's goal-setting activity.
lessons.main_activity: Children explain their chosen goal to a partner using 'I want to ___ because ___'.
key_questions: What is your goal?
Why do you want to achieve it?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note causal sentence use — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Share goals and reasons with the group.
lessons.home_link: Explain your goal and reason to your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: Introducing 'y'
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to say the sound 'y' and blend words (yes, yak, yum).
lessons.starter_activity: Recap sounds learned so far.
lessons.main_activity: Introduce 'y' sound/action; blend new CVC words.
key_questions: What sound is this?
Can you blend y-e-s?
lessons.assessment_notes: Update phonics tracker for 'y'.
lessons.plenary: Sing all 23 sounds learned.
lessons.home_link: Practise blending yes, yak, yum.

lessons.title: Shape and Pattern Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall 2D shape names and continue a pattern after the break.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap shape names learned in the autumn term.
lessons.main_activity: Assess/recap shape recognition and pattern continuation with a mixed activity station.
key_questions: What shape is this?
What comes next in the pattern?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the new term — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of shapes and patterns.
lessons.home_link: Look for shapes and patterns at home.

lessons.title: Making New Friends This Term
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to introduce themselves to a child they haven't played with much before.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the friend-making game from Week 1.
lessons.main_activity: Children pair up with someone new (facilitated by adult) and play a short game together, practising introductions.
key_questions: Who did you play with today?
What did you find out about them?

differentiation.support: Adult facilitates the pairing and conversation

lessons.assessment_notes: Note social confidence with less familiar peers — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.plenary: Share something new learned about a classmate.
lessons.home_link: Talk about a new friend or classmate you played with today.

lessons.title: Describing New Beginnings
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe something 'new' using descriptive vocabulary.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss things that feel new in January (new term, new books, new year).
lessons.main_activity: Children describe something new to them this term (a new book, activity, or friend) using descriptive words.
key_questions: What is new to you this term?
How does it feel to try something new?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note descriptive vocabulary — evidence for CL.2.
lessons.plenary: Class list of new things this term.
lessons.home_link: Talk about something new you're looking forward to.

lessons.title: Writing Recap: My Name and Simple Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to write their name and attempt simple CVC words after the break.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap name-writing from earlier in the year.
lessons.main_activity: Assess/recap name-writing and CVC word writing ability, noting progress since September.
key_questions: Can you write your name?
Can you write a simple word?

differentiation.extension: Write full name and simple CVC words independently

lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap of writing progress for the new term — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate everyone's writing progress since September.
lessons.home_link: Practise writing your name and simple words at home.

lessons.title: Doubling and Sharing Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to recall doubling and sharing concepts from before the break.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap doubling from Week 5.
lessons.main_activity: Assess/recap doubling small numbers and sharing fairly between two, using counters.
key_questions: What is double 3?
Can you share 6 fairly between two?
lessons.assessment_notes: Baseline recap for the new term — evidence for MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of doubling and sharing.
lessons.home_link: Practise doubling and sharing with snacks/toys at home.

lessons.title: Looking Forward to Spring Term
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to express excitement about something coming up this term.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's new beginnings learning.
lessons.main_activity: Children share one thing they are looking forward to this term (linked to upcoming topics), contributing to a class display.
key_questions: What are you looking forward to this term?
Why does it excite you?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note positive anticipation and reflective language — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class display reveal of things to look forward to.
lessons.home_link: Share what you're looking forward to this term with family.

lessons.title: New Beginnings Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about this week's learning.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's key vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking recall questions about goals, new things, and routines from the week.
key_questions: What is your new year goal?
What is new to you this term?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and listening comprehension — evidence for CL.1.
lessons.plenary: Team points tally, celebrate together.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on what you've learned this week.

lessons.title: Phonics Review: All 23 Sounds
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read CVC words and simple sentences using all sounds learned so far.
lessons.starter_activity: Quick-fire flashcard review of all 23 sounds.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations: word-building, CVC reading cards, simple sentence reading (e.g. 'yes, a fox can win').
key_questions: Can you build and read this word?
Can you read this sentence?
lessons.assessment_notes: Finalise week 15 phonics tracker.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate all sounds learned with a reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading simple sentences over the weekend.

lessons.title: Maths Review: Spring Term Baseline Recap
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to demonstrate their current level across key number and shape skills.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's maths vocabulary.
lessons.main_activity: Rotate through 3 stations: counting to 20 recap, shape/pattern recap, number bonds recap, allowing the teacher to note baseline levels for the spring term.
key_questions: How high can you count?
What shape/pattern is this?
What makes 5 or 10?
lessons.assessment_notes: Record spring term baseline levels for each child against MATHS.1/MATHS.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap game combining all three skills.
lessons.home_link: Continue practising counting and number skills over the weekend.
